chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, عليه السلام, said:

The man and woman sentenced to stoning are to be given ghusl, embalmed with hanut, and dressed in the shroud before that; then they are stoned and salat is performed over them. The one against whom retribution is carried out is in the same position: he is given ghusl, embalmed with hanut, dressed in the shroud, then executed in retaliation, and salat is performed over him.

key_terms.الْمُقْتَصُّ مِنْهُ: the one upon whom qisas is carried out
key_terms.يُحَنَّطَانِ: the two are embalmed with hanut
key_terms.يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ: the funeral prayer is performed over him
key_terms.يُغَسَّلَانِ: the two are washed with the ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: How are a person sentenced to stoning or qisas prepared according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the treatment of those condemned to stoning or execution by qisas. It states that they are to be prepared for burial before the punishment is carried out, and that the funeral prayer is still offered over them afterward.
